finalText:
Build's clean now. Two real bugs, not noise.

`resolveRetries` in `src/core/options.js` was reading `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands it `retryCount`. Fixed to read the right field.

`isBackoffEnabled` in `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when the flag was `undefined`. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. It now treats `undefined` as disabled, same as before.

`node build.js` finishes with `0 errors` now. The rest were plain deprecation noise from the bump, safe to leave.
